newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland sees 4.6 pct GDP growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Finland sees 4.6 pct GDP growth in 1997.

text.p: The Finnish finance ministry said in a new forecast on Tuesday that the pace of gross domestic product growth would accelerate to 4.6 percent this year and be nearly four percent in 1998.
"Growth is predicted to remain brisk throughout 1997 ... Total production is expected to grow almost four percent in 1998," the ministry said.

Inflation would remain slow this year and next with the consumer price index expected to rise 1.2 percent year-on-year in 1997 and by "a few percent" in 1998. "Only minor cost pressures are in view," the ministry said referring to 1997.
Looking towards 1998, it said: "If a moderate wage settlement is reached in the next round of collective bargaining, domestic price inflation will remain low."

The deficit/GDP ratio to qualify for EMU is below 3.0 percent, and the debt/GDP ceiling is 60 percent. Entrants will be chosen in spring 1998 based on economic performance in 1997.
